overview_description.description: UnitQ is an AI-enabled product quality monitoring platform that empowers companies to take a data-driven approach to product quality so they can fix the right quality issues faster. The company's customer feedback platform empowers users to identify quality issues simultaneously with their customers, pinpoint the impact of product launches, releases, or ongoing features generating the most bugs or support tickets, and delve deep into issue origins across various sources, platforms, devices, customer segments, and beyond.

about_short_description.short_description: UnitQ is an AI enabled platform that monitors and transforms product quality with real-time customer feedback insights.

product.name: unitQ Platform
product.description: An AI-powered quality intelligence platform that aggregates customer feedback and operational data, classifies issues, connects them to business KPIs, and supports real-time product and customer experience analysis.

product.name: monitorQ
product.description: A customer intelligence product that analyzes feedback across channels to detect emerging product and service issues, identify trends, and support faster issue resolution.

product.name: metricQ
product.description: A business-impact analysis product that links customer feedback and behavioral data to metrics such as revenue, retention, engagement, CSAT, and NPS.

product.name: agentQ
product.description: An autonomous AI assistant for querying customer feedback and engagement data, generating cited insights, visualizations, recommendations, and root-cause analysis.

product.name: competeQ
product.description: A competitive intelligence product that analyzes public competitor feedback to benchmark product quality, identify customer friction, and track market trends by region, feature, and experience.

product.name: supportQ
product.description: An AI-powered support quality assurance product that evaluates human agent and bot interactions, identifies coaching opportunities, and flags compliance or service risks.
